en: A sepia-toned image showing a colonial-style two‑storey building with an arched arcade on the ground floor and a balcony corridor above, set in front of a landscaped town square or garden with curving paths, flowerbeds, trees, and a statue on a pedestal. Hills or mountains rise steeply behind the town, with a small church complex visible on a slope to the right. Utility poles and wires run across the scene, and a few people can be seen walking near the building and in the square.
